title: A2UI v0.9: The New Standard for Portable, Framework-Agnostic Generative UI
summary_zh: A2UI v0.9 引入了框架无关的生成式 UI 标准，允许 AI 智能体使用通用语言与任何客户端应用程序通信。该版本包含 Python Agent SDK、共享的 Web 核心库，以及官方支持的 React、Flutter、Angular 渲染器。通过将 UI 意图与特定平台解耦，A2UI v0.9 旨在将生成式 UI 从实验演示转变为生产级数字产品，与 AG2 和 Vercel 等更广泛的生态系统集成。
summary_en: A2UI v0.9 introduces a framework-agnostic standard designed to help AI agents generate real-time, tailored UI widgets using a company's existing design system. This update simplifies the developer experience with a new Agent SDK for Python, a shared web-core library, and official support for renderers like React, Flutter, and Angular. By decoupling UI intent from specific platforms, the release enables seamless, low-latency streaming of generative interfaces across web and mobile applications.
one_liner: A2UI 正在成为生成式 UI 的标准接口，解决智能体与客户端通信的互操作性问题

title: Build with Google Antigravity, our new agentic development platform
summary_zh: Google 发布 Antigravity 新一代智能体开发平台，将传统 AI 编码体验与智能体优先界面结合。平台提供 Editor View（AI 驱动的 IDE）和 Manager Surface（智能体调度界面）两种交互方式。支持将复杂多工具任务委托给 Agent 自动执行，通过 Artifacts（任务清单、实现计划、截图等）验证代理工作成果。支持多语言 SDK，兼容 Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5 和 GPT-OSS，跨平台支持 macOS、Windows、Linux。
summary_en: Google launches Antigravity, a new agentic development platform combining AI-powered coding experience with agent-first interface. Features Editor View (AI-powered IDE) and Manager Surface (agent orchestration interface). Supports delegating complex multi-tool tasks to agents, verified through Artifacts. Compatible with multiple models and languages, cross-platform support available.
one_liner: Google Antigravity 将传统 IDE 与智能体调度完美融合，代表开发平台的下一代演进

title: Gemini 3 Flash: Pro-Grade Coding Performance with Low Latency and Cost
summary_zh: Gemini 3 Flash 现已集成到 Gemini CLI 中，提供 Pro 级编码性能的同时具有低延迟和低成本优势。SWE-bench 验证得分达到 76%，与 Gemini 3 Pro 相当，显著优于 2.5 Pro 版本。特别适合高频开发任务，能够处理复杂代码生成、大上下文窗口（如处理 1000 条评论的 PR）、快速生成负载测试脚本等场景。已面向 Google AI Ultra 和付费 Gemini API 用户开放（需 CLI 升级至 0.16.x）。
summary_en: Gemini 3 Flash integrated into Gemini CLI delivers Pro-grade coding performance with low latency and cost. Matches Gemini 3 Pro's SWE-bench Verified score of 76%, significantly outperforming 2.5 Pro. Ideal for high-frequency development tasks handling complex code generation, large context windows, and quick load test script generation. Available for Google AI Ultra and paid Gemini API users (CLI upgrade to 0.16.x required).
one_liner: Gemini 3 Flash 在 Gemini CLI 中实现性能与成本的完美平衡

title: LangGraph: Build resilient language agents as graphs
summary_zh: LangGraph 是构建长生命周期、有状态智能体的低级编排框架。提供持久化执行（通过失败后自动恢复）、人机协作（检查和修改代理状态）、综合记忆（短期工作记忆和长期持久记忆）、与 LangSmith 集成的调试功能，以及专为有状态工作流设计的生产级部署。被 Klarna、Replit、Elastic 等公司信赖，支持构建能够循环、分支和暂停检查点的智能体。
summary_en: LangGraph provides low-level supporting infrastructure for any long-running, stateful workflow or agent. Features include durable execution (agents that persist through failures), human-in-the-loop oversight, comprehensive memory (both short-term working memory and long-term persistent memory), debugging with LangSmith visualization tools, and production-ready deployment for complex agent systems.
one_liner: LangGraph 正成为构建生产级有状态智能体的标准编排框架

title: CrewAI: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents
summary_zh: CrewAI 是一个轻量级的 Python 框架，完全从头构建，独立于 LangChain。支持 Crews（优化自主性和协作智能）和 Flows（构建和部署多系统的企业架构）。提供高层次的简洁性和精确的低级控制，适合为任何场景创建自主 AI 智能体。已有超过 100,000 开发者通过社区课程获得认证，正在成为企业级 AI 自动化的标准。
summary_en: CrewAI is a lean, lightning-fast Python framework built entirely from scratch—completely independent of LangChain. It empowers developers with both high-level simplicity and precise low-level control for creating autonomous AI agents. Supports Crews for autonomy optimization and Flows for enterprise multi-agent systems. With over 100,000 certified developers, it's rapidly becoming the standard for enterprise-ready AI automation.
one_liner: CrewAI 以角色扮演和协作智能为核心，正在成为多智能体系统的企业标准

title: AutoGen: A programming framework for agentic AI
summary_zh: AutoGen 是一个用于创建多智能体 AI 应用程序的框架，可以自主运行或与人类协作。目前处于维护模式，不再接收新功能或增强功能，由社区管理。新用户应使用 Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF)，这是 AutoGen 的企业就绪继任者，提供稳定的 API 和长期支持支持。现有用户鼓励使用迁移指南迁移到 MAF。
summary_en: AutoGen is a framework for creating multi-agent AI applications that can act autonomously or work alongside humans. Currently in maintenance mode—no new features or enhancements, community managed. Users should migrate to Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), the enterprise-ready successor with production APIs and long-term support.
one_liner: AutoGen 进入维护模式，用户应迁移到微软新的 Agent Framework
